title: Release Radar: Roadmap Traffic & Risk Catalog
content:
PURPOSE:
A compact, action-first working doc to combine roadmap traffic (what lands when), the KPIs we’ll watch during rollout, and a simple risk -> trigger -> contingency catalog. Intended for product-ops, release owners, and on-call rotation during first 72 hours. This is intentionally light-weight and iterative — use it as the single source for go/no-go signals.

CURRENT SCOPE / CONTEXT:
- Release window: phased rollout across Hosted API and Dedicated clusters (region: us-west-2 -> eu-west-1).
- Primary customers in this wave: early enterprise pilots and high-traffic PLG orgs.
- Release artifacts: API v2 route flags, autoscale tuning, observability dashboards, canary config. See linked artifacts above for tickets and config PRs.

1) ROADMAP TRAFFIC (milestone tracker) — quick view
- Milestone: Feature freeze for API v2 route and SDKs | Owner: Priya Patel | Target: 2025-09-05 | Status: complete
- Milestone: Canary deploy to 5% hosted traffic (us-west-2) | Owner: Diego Ramos | Target: 2025-09-12 | Status: complete
- Milestone: Expand to 25% + Dedicated smoke | Owner: Liam O'Connor | Target: 2025-09-18 | Status: complete
- Milestone: EU regional enable | Owner: Evelyn Park | Target: 2025-10-01 | Status: in_progress
- Milestone: Full global rollout | Owner: Maya Chen | Target: 2025-10-08 | Status: planned

Notes: timeboxes are aggressive. If any critical KPI breaches during 5%->25% step, pause and run containment checklist.

2) KPI DEFINITIONS & TARGETS (what to watch)
- API p50 latency (text-gen, 1k token window): target < 120ms | warning 120-200ms | critical >200ms
- API error-rate (5xx & 4xx from server): target < 0.1% | warning 0.1%-0.5% | critical >0.5%
- Token cost per 1k tokens: baseline = $0.96 | expect +/-10% during gradual rollout
- Throughput (tokens/sec per host): baseline 12k | monitor for 20% degradation
- Model quality regressions (eval set BLEU / pass-rate): target no regression >2% from baseline on golden prompts
- Customer-facing adoption: pilot accounts enabled / active = 6/8 by day 7

Quick tracking shorthand (to be updated in the dashboard row): p50 | err% | cost | quality | adoption.

3) READINESS / GO-NO GO CHECKLIST (core gating)
- [ ] Infra autoscale policy validated under 2x synthetic load (OWNER: SRE on-call) — ticket: ENG-2345
- [ ] Canary monitoring wired to alert channels (PagerDuty + slack #release-ops) — OWNER: Observability
- [ ] Smoke tests signed off (SDKs + REST): passing on dedicated pool — OWNER: QA lead
- [ ] Backward compatibility: API v1 -> v2 flag fallback tested — OWNER: Devrel
- [ ] Rollback playbook (fast route toggle) published & rehearsed — OWNER: Maya Chen
- [ ] Customer comms draft and staged emails + status page copy — OWNER: Customer Success
- [ ] Postmortem template prepared for 72h — OWNER: Product-ops

Status notes: most items done except final customer comms and EU infra tests (Evelyn).

4) CONTINGENCY / RISK CATALOG (compact)
- Risk: Sudden spike in 5xxs during 25% expansion
  - Trigger: sustained >0.5% 5xx over 10 minutes OR error-rate slope incr >0.2%/5m
  - Immediate action: throttle rollout at 10% traffic and flip route to previous model variant for affected region
  - Secondary: spin up isolated dedicated capacity, increase batching window, open incident bridge
  - Owner: SRE lead / Release owner

- Risk: Latency regression tied to KV cache miss pattern
  - Trigger: p50 up >120ms and cache hit ratio drops >15% vs baseline
  - Immediate action: enable aggressive prefix caching on route, deploy hotfix to cache config, revert heavy quantization flags if implemented
  - Owner: Serving-runtime eng

- Risk: Model quality regression on golden prompts
  - Trigger: automated eval shows >2% drop on eval set or >3 customer-reported mismatches in first 24h
  - Immediate action: auto-fallback to previous verified model variant for affected tenants; suspend A/B tests; notify CS and PD
  - Owner: Applied ML / Product

- Risk: Cost spike above committed billing threshold for Dedicated customers
  - Trigger: 20% increase in tokens consumed per minute vs expected with no adoption cause
  - Immediate action: halve nonessential background jobs, reroute non-critical traffic to lower-cost model variants, engage finance for temporary invoice cap
  - Owner: Product Finance / Infra

5) ROLLOUT PHASING (practical)
- Phase A (Canary): 5% hosted in us-west-2 + smoke Dedicated tests | Duration target: 24-48h | Success = no critical triggers and <0.1% err
- Phase B (Broader): 25% hosted + Dedicated baseline | Duration target: 48-72h | Success = KPIs stable, EU infra green
- Phase C (Regional): Enable eu-west-1 at 10% initially; monitor regional signals for 72h then expand
- Phase D: Full global enable; monitor 7-day sliding window for regressions

6) OBSERVABILITY & ESCALATION (who gets paged)
- Pager on-call -> top of escalation for infra + errors
- Product-ops channel (slack) -> first responders and cross-functional synth
- Exec notify list -> only for critical service-impacting incidents (SLA breach or multi-region outage)

7) 72-HOUR RUNBOOK (post-rollout checklist)
- Hour 0-6: confirm smoke tests, confirm canary metrics, customer outreach to pilots
- Hour 6-24: daily sync at +6h and +18h with SRE/AppliedML/CS/Product; capture any anomalies in incident doc
- Day 1-3: begin performance-optimization tickets (batching, cache tuning) and monitor quality drift; sign off incremental opt-ins

8) OWNER MAP & CONTACTS (quick)
- Release owner: Maya Chen (product-ops) -> maya@redwood.ai
- SRE lead: Diego Ramos -> diego@redwood.ai
- Observability: Liam O'Connor -> liam@redwood.ai
- EU infra lead: Evelyn Park -> evelyn@redwood.ai
- Applied ML: Priya Patel -> priya@redwood.ai

OPEN QUESTIONS / TODOS (notes to self)
- Confirm legal/compliance approval for EU data routing (Evelyn) — blocking for eu enable
- Finalize customer success playbook for rollback messaging (Priya)
- Decide on lower-cost model variant threshold for automated fallback (Product + Finance)
- Add lightweight smoke script for Dedicated that simulates KV/cache churn (TODO: SRE)
APPROACH & DECISIONS LOG (short)
- 2025-09-12: canary confirmed healthy; decided to expand to 25% based on p50 and error rate margins
- 2025-09-18: observed minor latency bump in one Dedicated pool; increased prefetch cache and saw improvement — no rollback

NEXT STEPS (immediate)
- Evelyn: finish EU infra validation by 2025-09-26 (blocking for Phase C)
- Maya: publish final rollback playbook and run 15-min rehearsal with SRE (2025-09-20)
- Priya: finalize CS customer comms and pre-write status page copy (2025-09-22)

(End of working doc — please add updates inline; if you copy to Confluence, link back to this file as the working source.)
